spain.h1: Golf properties for sale in Spain
spain.lead: Villas, townhouses and apartments on or near the best golf courses of the Costa Blanca, the Costa del Sol and the Costa Cálida. Choose a coast, then a golf course.
intro: Spain has some of the best golf in Europe and the sun to play it all year. We sell golf homes on three coasts: the Costa Blanca around Alicante, the Costa del Sol around Marbella, and the Costa Cálida in the Region of Murcia.

The Costa Blanca has more choice at lower prices, with many new resorts in the south and courses close to Alicante airport. The Costa del Sol has the famous golf valleys of Marbella, Benahavís, Estepona and Mijas, with higher prices and more luxury homes. The Costa Cálida, around the Mar Menor, has flat resort courses and the lowest prices of the three.
faq: Costa Blanca or Costa del Sol for a golf home?

The Costa Blanca is cheaper and has many new golf resorts with apartments from about €260,000. The Costa del Sol has more famous courses and a more international, luxury feel, with prices that are usually higher. Many buyers choose by airport and budget.
Do I need to play golf to buy on a golf resort?
No. Many owners do not play. They choose golf resorts for the green views, the quiet, the security and the restaurants and sports clubs. Membership is optional and paid separately.
Can I rent out a golf property?
Often yes, but holiday rental needs a tourist licence from the region and some communities do not allow it. Ask us before you buy and we will check the rules for the home you like.

intro: Most golf resorts on the Costa Blanca are in the south, between Alicante and Murcia: Las Colinas, La Finca, Vistabella and La Marquesa. They have new villas and apartments, sunny weather all year and sandy beaches 10–20 minutes away.
Around Alicante itself, Bonalba, Font del Llop and Alenda put you close to the city and the airport. Further north, Puig Campana in Finestrat has mountain and sea views next to Benidorm.
faq: Which is the best golf resort on the Costa Blanca?

It depends on what you want. Las Colinas is the most exclusive and has won many awards. La Finca has a five-star hotel and lots of choice. Font del Llop and Bonalba are close to Alicante and the airport, and La Marquesa is inside a town with shops open all year.

intro: The Costa Cálida is the coast of the Region of Murcia, around the Mar Menor lagoon. It has more than 20 golf courses, most of them flat resort courses with lakes, a short drive from the beaches and from Región de Murcia airport at Corvera.

Prices are lower than on the Costa Blanca, so it is popular with buyers who want a villa with a private pool near golf for a moderate budget. Below, each golf course has the properties we sell nearest to it.

courses.name: La Serena Golf
courses.facts: 18 holes · par 72 · by Manuel Piñero · opened 2006
text: La Serena Golf is a flat championship course on the edge of Los Alcázares, designed by the Spanish Ryder Cup player Manuel Piñero. Water comes into play on 16 of the 18 holes, so lakes are the main challenge.
The new villas and apartments around the course are about 1 km from the beaches of the Mar Menor, and Los Alcázares has shops, restaurants and a promenade open all year.
town_link: All our properties in Los Alcázares

courses.name: Roda Golf
text: Roda Golf in San Javier is an 18-hole course designed by Dave Thomas, on flat land with many lakes, between Los Alcázares and Santiago de la Ribera.
Our nearest homes are villas and apartments in San Javier, about 1 km from the Mar Menor beaches and close to the Roda course.

courses.name: La Torre Golf and Mar Menor Golf
courses.facts: La Torre: 18 holes, par 68, Nicklaus Design · Mar Menor Golf: 18 holes, par 72
text: Torre-Pacheco has several courses close together. La Torre Golf in Roldán, and Saurines next to it, were built by Nicklaus Design. Mar Menor Golf Resort started as a 9-hole course by Dave Thomas and was extended to 18 holes by Nicklaus Design.
Our homes here are in Roldán and Torre-Pacheco: new villas with private pools and bungalows in the El Alba resort, a short drive from these courses and about 15 minutes from the Mar Menor.

courses.name: Hacienda del Álamo Golf
courses.facts: 18 holes · par 72 · by Dave Thomas · about 6,700 m
text: Hacienda del Álamo is one of the longest courses in Spain, about 6,700 metres from the back tees, designed by Dave Thomas in the open countryside of Fuente Álamo.
The resort has apartments and villas with golf views, many with a private pool, at some of the lowest prices of any golf resort on the coast.

courses.name: El Valle Golf
text: El Valle Golf is a Nicklaus Design course in Baños y Mendigo, south of the city of Murcia, with lakes, streams and small waterfalls among dry hills.
The new apartments and villas next to the course are about 25 km from the city of Murcia and around 15 minutes from Región de Murcia airport.

courses.name: La Manga Club
text: La Manga Club is one of the best-known golf resorts in Spain: 560 hectares with three 18-hole courses. The North and South courses were designed by Robert Dean Putman, and the West course by Dave Thomas in 1996.
The resort also has a hotel, tennis, football pitches and restaurants, and the beaches of the Mediterranean and La Manga are a few minutes away.

La Serena Golf in Los Alcázares and Roda Golf in San Javier are about 1 km from the Mar Menor. La Manga Club is a few minutes from the Mediterranean beaches.
What costs are there on top of the price?

In the Region of Murcia you pay 10% VAT and 1.5% stamp duty on a new build, or 7.75% transfer tax on a resale home. Add about 1.5–2.5% for the notary, land registry and lawyer. We give you the exact figure for the home you like.
